categories.name: Air Filter
categories.desc: Engine air filters that remove dust and suspended particles from intake air before it reaches the combustion chamber, reducing cylinder, piston and piston-ring wear.

categories.name: Cabin Filter
categories.desc: Cabin air filters that capture dust, pollen and particulate from outside air before it enters the passenger cabin.

categories.name: Oil Filter
categories.desc: Engine oil filters that remove contaminants and carbon sludge from circulating engine oil, protecting lubrication components and extending oil life.

categories.name: Fuel Filter
categories.desc: Fuel filters that remove iron oxide, dust and other impurities from fuel to prevent fuel-system blockage and reduce mechanical wear.

categories.name: Wiper
categories.desc: Wiper blades and related wiper products for clear visibility.
